text:
Lina: Tiny poll — who wants a 'Model Mascot Day' where we bring plushies representing different model types? :tada::robot_face:
Marco: Yes! I'll bring a floppy-eared 'RNN' bunny and name it 'Recurly' :rabbit:
Ivy: I'm down. Can we also do tiny bios? e.g., 'Recurly: forgets the punchline but hugs anyway' :laughing:
Doug: Vote: :one: this Friday lunch :two: next Wednesday after demo :three: skip.
Lina: Also idea: quick game — impersonate a model with one sentence. Example: 'As an AI, I must clarify, but here's a haiku.'
Marco: "As an AI, I cannot taste, but that cupcake seems 10/10." :cupcake:
Ivy: I'll write tiny name tags: 'Greedy-Gryphon', 'Softmax Susan', 'Dropout Dave'
party-bot: Poll posted: react with :one: :two: or :three: — poll closes in 6h
Doug: :one: lunch works. I'll order cupcakes if kitchen's OK.
Lina: Nice. Also low-stakes contest: best mascot backstory wins a sticker. Winners get to pick office playlist for the day.
Marco: Challenge accepted. I'm writing Recurly's tragic origin story now.
